## Features
- Smart Lighting Control  Use the Hello Fairy app or included remote to adjust brightness, colours and lighting modes from a distance.
- 30cm Foldable Black Frame  The sleek metal sphere creates a modern decorative look and folds flat after use for easier seasonal storage.
- Flexible Indoor and Outdoor Display  Suitable for decorating porches, patios, entrances and indoor spaces, with a 3m lead cable to give you more freedom when positioning the light. Transformer must remain indoors and dry.

## Information
Add vibrant festive colour to your home or garden with the Pegdev 30cm RGB Colour Changing Foldable Christmas Ball Light. Designed with a sleek 30cm black metal ball frame, this decorative light features micro lights positioned around the frame to create an eye-catching multicolour display that works well for Christmas decorating, parties and seasonal displays. Choose and adjust the lighting using the Hello Fairy App or the included handheld remote control, giving you an easy way to customise the colour and lighting effects to suit your setting. The black frame provides a clean, modern look while allowing the illuminated colours to stand out clearly when switched on. Suitable for indoor and outdoor decorating, the ball can be displayed around patios, porches, entrances, covered outdoor areas and other festive spaces. For outdoor use, the transformer should always be kept indoors and dry. The clever foldable design also makes the decoration simple to set up and store. Simply open the partially assembled frame gently and secure it together to create the full 30cm spherical shape. Once Christmas is over, the ball folds flat again for compact, convenient storage until it is needed next season.

- Set of 5 acrylic Christmas tree lights for indoor or outdoor use
- Each Christmas tree measures 13.5cm x 10.5cm x 3cm (approx.)
- Illuminated by 40 static white LEDs for an enchanting glow

## Information
Bring a magical festive glow to your home or garden with this Set of 5 Acrylic Christmas Tree Lights from Christow. Crafted from clear acrylic and lit by 40 static white LEDs, they’re shaped like mini Christmas trees with stars on top for an enchanting festive look. Display them indoors or outdoors along windowsills, mantelpieces, or patio walls, with a battery-powered design and built-in timer for easy placement. Clear Acrylic with White LEDs Made from durable clear acrylic, the Christmas tree lights are shatter-resistant, waterproof, and perfect for indoor or outdoor use. Their transparent design enhances the glow of the static white LEDs to create an enchanting festive feature. Outdoor-Safe Battery Pack The Christmas tree lights are powered by an IP44-rated battery pack for safe indoor or outdoor use. A 50cm clear lead wire allows flexible placement, while the discreet cable blends neatly into its surroundings for a cleaner festive display. Timer Function Designed for convenience, the built-in timer allows the Christmas tree lights to switch on at the same time each evening and turn off automatically after six hours. A manual setting also gives you full control whenever needed. Space Up to 30cm Apart Each Christmas tree is connected by a 30cm cable, allowing you to position the first and last tree up to 120cm apart. Arrange them along a windowsill or mantelpiece, or group them together to create a magical festive display. 9306254.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Magical Illumination for Christmas: Transform your Xmas decorations with a dazzling display featuring 40 + 60 + 100 warm white LED lights. The lighted present box set offers a gentle, welcoming glow that fills your party with festive cheer.
- Festive Holiday Design Full of Charm: Each light up present box is adorned with an elegant golden bow and dazzling glitter tinsel accents, adding finishing touches of luxury and cheer that perfectly complement your holiday display.

- Versatile Indoor & Outdoor Use: Enjoy ultimate flexibility in holiday decorating with this pre-lit Xmas gift box set, designed for both indoor and outdoor use. Featuring an IP44 rating, it ensures your festive display shines brightly and stays protected.

## Information
Brighten your holiday celebrations with this stunning lighted gift box set, featuring warm white LED lights in counts of 40, 60, and 100 that cast a gentle, welcoming glow both during daytime and nighttime. Each illuminated present is adorned with shimmering tinsel and elegant golden bows, adding a touch of festive sophistication to your decorations. The sturdy metal frames, coated for durability, ensure these decorative boxes remain a cherished part of your seasonal tradition for years to come. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor displays, the set boasts an IP44 rating for a safe long term use. With no assembly required and a clever nesting design for compact storage, this festive decoration set combines convenience with charm. Designed to make your Christmas celebration even more magical, these dazzling gift boxes effortlessly enhance any setting with warmth and joyful sparkle. From all of us, merry Christmas!
